traces.description: Proves the two <parallel> regions (auth, caps) advance independently of each other: caps reaches its <final> while auth is still pending, and auth then fails and retries without disturbing caps' already-final state, before both regions are simultaneously final.

steps.note: caps region reaches its own <final> while auth is still mid-negotiation -- the two regions are not lockstepped.
auth region fails independently; caps' already-final leaf is untouched by this event.
both regions now simultaneously final -- this is the configuration that triggers done.state.negotiating.
